title: Score a language model with next-token loss
brief: Write the per-token loss without overflow, cut a text into inputs and shifted targets, and read the loss as perplexity.
hints: per_token_loss: logp = logits - torch.logsumexp(logits, dim=-1, keepdim=True), then pick each row's target with logp.gather(-1, targets.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1) and flip the sign. Never form the softmax first, because it overflows.

make_lm_batch: inputs are tokens[start : start + block_size] and targets are tokens[start + 1 : start + block_size + 1]. Check that start + block_size + 1 is at most len(tokens) and raise ValueError otherwise.
perplexity is math.exp(float(loss)). A uniform guess over k words has loss log k, so its perplexity must come out as k.
